title: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
content: Analysts see no direct link between Nvidia and bitcoin's decline, pointing instead to investor capital headed into Anthropic as well as a broader risk-off move.

title: U.S. Senate Banking Committee races toward hearing on new SEC nominations
content: The committee that needs to advance President Donald Trump's nominees responded quickly to set his SEC picks for review next week.

title: Bitcoin heads for sixth weekly loss as Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO looms
content: Bitcoin is down 21% this year as investors weigh Anthropic’s anticipated listing, Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and rising Fed rate hike expectations.

title: Kraken parent Payward says expansion outside crypto trading helps cushion revenue decline
content: While earnings and the company’s newly introduced financial performance measure remained below year-earlier levels, there are signs of improvement from the second quarter.

content: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 13, 2026

title: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
content: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.

title: Bitcoin holds below $70K as stocks slip despite a cooler US PPI print
content: Bitcoin was down about 4% on the day amid a tepid market reaction to October’s US PPI reading, which came in below expected levels.

title: Arthur Hayes ‘flattered’ as Coinbase backs US stock perps
content: Arthur Hayes said he was “flattered” by Coinbase’s defense of US stock perpetual futures, a decade after BitMEX launched perpetual swaps.

title: Nakamoto shares fall 6% premarket after Q3 revenue turns negative
content: A $5.8 million Bitcoin options loss pushed Nakamoto’s quarterly operating revenue below zero, while the company extended repayment of $60 million in Kraken debt to 2027.

title: China’s $3.2 Billion AI Pipeline Still Calls for Nvidia Chips Washington Restricts
content: Chinese data center projects are still being designed around restricted Nvidia processors, even as Beijing pushes domestic alternatives.

title: JPMorgan’s Bitcoin and Crypto-Linked Holdings Approach $1 Billion
content: The bank’s Q3 13F shows roughly $981 million across Bitcoin ETFs, Strategy and Coinbase—likely over $1 billion counting Robinhood and miners.

title: Dormant Bitcoin Wallets Wake Up After 16 Years, Moving $6.9 Million
content: Two Bitcoin mining rewards from September 2010 moved minutes apart. The coins are worth nearly 1.15 million times their original market value.

title: Fed Chair Warsh Wants Answers on AI Inflation—and Bitcoin May Feel the Impact
content: The Federal Reserve is examining whether AI will lower prices or keep inflation elevated, a question that could shape interest rates and the outlook for crypto.

title: Trump’s First Democratic Picks for SEC and CFTC Could Reshape Crypto’s Regulators
content: The bipartisan slate—two Republicans and two Democrats, Trump’s first Democratic picks for either agency—would refill commissions that have driven crypto policy since the Clarity Act’s collapse.

title: FutureBit’s Apollo III Bitcoin Miner Hits Micro Center Shelves in Its First Brick-and-Mortar Launch
content: Bitcoin Magazine FutureBit’s Apollo III Bitcoin Miner Hits Micro Center Shelves in Its First Brick-and-Mortar Launch The Brooklyn company's compact home miner, rated at up to 18 TH/s and starting at $1,099.99, goes on sale Friday at four Micro Center stores, including the chain's new Austin location. title: Robinhood’s Crypto Trading Volume Falls 48% in October as Event Contracts More Than Double
content: Bitcoin Magazine Robinhood’s Crypto Trading Volume Falls 48% in October as Event Contracts More Than Double Robinhood customers traded $17 billion of crypto in October, down 48% from a year earlier, while event contracts traded jumped 136% to 5.9 billion.
